idea-plugin.name: Claude Usage Monitor
idea-plugin.description:
Shows your Claude usage in the IDE status bar, bottom-right:

  • Subscription quota — 5-hour, 7-day and 7-day-Sonnet limits with a percentage, a color indicator and the time until the next reset. Read straight from the credentials the Claude Code CLI already stores, so there is nothing to log in to.
  • Token & cost breakdown — input / output / cache tokens and an estimated USD cost for today, the last 7 days, the last 30 days and all time, computed locally from the Claude Code transcript logs in ~/.claude/projects.

Click the widget for the full breakdown. Configure it under Settings → Tools → Claude Usage Monitor.

Requirements: the Claude Code CLI installed and authenticated (~/.claude/.credentials.json).

Free and open source (MIT). The subscription-quota endpoint used here is undocumented and may change without notice; the token/cost view keeps working regardless.
